data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior year release of $9.3m in 2022 (2021: $33.1m) driven by favourable reserve development across MAP Risks and Property Risks, partially offset by adverse movements (strengthening) in Cyber Risks relating to the 2020 underwriting year. Prior years had been impacted by events including the COVID-19 pandemic and a number of natural catastrophes (eg Hurricane Laura, Hurricane Ida, Storm Uri), but the 2022 net release indicates prior-year claims experience was slightly favourable overall.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding) at 31/12/2021. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement line was found; narrative provides a NET prior year release of $9.3m which has been used as the prior_year_development figure (NET of reinsurance). A gross movement figure was not presented in a standalone 'movement in prior year's claims' table. Claims development triangle in the notes contains ultimate and outstanding amounts and percentages but not explicit absolute development-period rows suitable for direct gross PYD extraction; therefore NET narrative figure used as fallback.

_claims_triangle.notes: The report provides gross ratios by development age and 'Total ultimate losses' and 'Gross claims liabilities' by underwriting year, but does not provide the full set of absolute development-period rows ('At end of underwriting year', 'One year later', etc.) in monetary amounts needed to compute the prior year movement via the triangle. Consequently development_rows are not supplied.
